info.title: Future You API
info.description: Engine and API for Future You (PNC 360° Financial Health Navigator).

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: APY for deposits, APR for debts, in percent

unused.title: Unused
unused.description: Subscription with no recent use (plan rule 3 cancels it)

date.title: Date
date.description: Date (yearly uses its month/day; once uses it exactly)

text.title: Text
text.description: The whole sheet as one block, sent to the agent as a dynamic variable

cash_series.title: Cash Series
cash_series.description: Daily checking balance band for 12 months

overdraft_risk_90d.description: Chance checking drops below $0 in the next 90 days

risk_days.title: Risk Days
risk_days.description: Days where the bad case goes below $0

value.description: The measured value, e.g. 78% card use

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: True when the same event hits both paths (e.g. the 2028 car repair)

Math.title: Math
Math.description: Everything 'show the math' needs to explain one number.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where it came from, e.g. 'Spend account balance'

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: e.g. score change, cushion change by 2031

key_numbers.title: Key Numbers
key_numbers.description: 2031: cushion, card debt, car paid off, IRA

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Exactly two plain sentences for the top of Today

bills.title: Bills
bills.description: Every recurring and one-time bill, with its due rule

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: e.g. net worth, total cash, total debt

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Must be true: nothing moves without a clear yes

deltas.title: Deltas
deltas.description: Change vs. before this what-if, e.g. '+$11k by 2031'

sentence.title: Sentence
sentence.description: One ready-made sentence the agent can say

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: All what-ifs active on the plan path, in order

description.title: Description
description.description: The change in the user's own words
